description: Probe one Linux machine — this host (`local`) or a remote host over SSH (`ssh`) — and report its OS, kernel, architecture, package manager, Node/npm, OpenCode, Docker, and per-tool detection flags, plus the names (never values) of credentials present. Read-only: it runs one shell probe as the target user (over SSH when `mode:ssh`), installs nothing, writes nothing, contacts no external service, and can take a few seconds per hop. Parameter semantics: `target.mode` selects local vs ssh (default `local`); `target.host` is required only for ssh; `target.user` defaults to the ssh config/current user; `target.cwd` sets the directory for relative checks; `target.port`/`identityFile` pass straight to ssh. Use it to see what a clone would touch, then plan_clone to turn that into an ordered plan and apply_clone to perform it.

target.description: The machine to operate on: this host (local) or a remote host over SSH (ssh).

mode.description: Run on this machine (local) or a remote host (ssh).

user.description: SSH user (defaults to ssh config / current user).

name: inspect_target

configDir.description: OpenCode config directory on the target.

dockerRunning.description: Whether the Docker daemon is reachable.

envPresent.description: Space-separated names of credentials present on the target (values are never read).

has.description: Detection flags for git, curl, node, npm, corepack, pnpm, docker, uv, gh, opencode, sudo.

opencodeBin.description: Path to the opencode binary, if installed.

packageManager.description: Detected package manager (apt-get, dnf, yum, apk, pacman, zypper, or none).

workspaceDefault.description: Default directory where the profile repo will be cloned.

title: Inspect a Linux target
